root_causes.finding: V2.4 inventories propositions but does not require an explicit comparison of modality, certainty, and time for the same governed event before open-class semantic labeling.
root_causes.effect: The model notices an unsafe factual return but misses possibility-to-actuality and future-to-during-event mutations.

root_causes.finding: The model treats 'as if rules changed during the match' as proof of real causality and actor intent, although the construction supplies neither a real cause-effect link nor a real actor's purpose.
root_causes.effect: Causality and motive become spurious attractor classes.

root_causes.finding: V2.4 asks for all material classes but does not distinguish one core unsupported proposition expressed across multiple authority axes from independent unsupported propositions.
root_causes.effect: Every detected class is promoted to DECISIVE instead of assigning certainty as the core contradiction and timing/stakes as supporting dimensions.

root_causes.finding: The first reason's candidate_span copied the factual summary's possible-future wording, which is absent from the candidate.
root_causes.effect: The receipt is not auditable and the purported trigger does not ground the observed class.

delta_first_analysis: Extract the governed event, its modality/certainty, and its time/status from factual authority.
Extract the corresponding event commitment, modality/certainty, and time/status carried by the candidate, including presupposition, entailment, and necessary implication.
Compare matched event axes before considering open-class motive, causality, emotion, or outcome labels.

When authority says possible/future and commentary commits to changed/ongoing/completed reality, record certainty and timing mutation even if the commitment appears inside analogy or counterfactual framing.
negative_evidence_for_open_classes: Do not emit FSEM_UNSUPPORTED_MOTIVE_OR_INTENT unless the candidate commits to a real actor or institution plus a real goal, purpose, plan, protective design, or reason for acting.
Do not emit FSEM_UNSUPPORTED_CAUSALITY unless the candidate commits to two real propositions joined by an unsupported cause-effect relation.
Analogy between a real event and a game does not itself supply real intent or causality.
proposition_grouping_and_status: Group reason classes that describe different authority-axis mutations of the same core real-world proposition.
Mark DECISIVE the minimal core contradiction sufficient to reject the grouped proposition.
Mark additional dimensions of that same proposition SUPPORTING unless independently sufficient and independently grounded.
For possibility-to-changed-reality with future-to-during-event shift, certainty is DECISIVE and timing is SUPPORTING.
A separate unsupported life-stakes proposition remains SUPPORTING when the core authority mutation already decides rejection.
span_grounding: Every non-null candidate_span must be a byte-exact contiguous substring of candidate commentary and must carry the proposition or mutation named by that record.
Every non-null authority_support must be a byte-exact contiguous substring of the governed factual summary.
Candidate and authority source fields are not interchangeable.
A deterministic post-parse source-membership check should fail closed on a non-member span; it must not repair, replace, or relabel the model output.
